name: EDDIE MASTER EDITOR
calibration: Calibrate once just below the beard/base of neck; keep captions stationary and pictures directly below the reserved caption bounds. Reference coordinates are starting points.

iphoneMessages.activation: Explicit request for text messages or iPhone notifications on screen

rapidFire.selection: Auto-detect repeated short Q&A, yes/no or ranking script unless user specifies otherwise
rapidFire.imageSource: Google images, unless user supplies or selects alternatives

hook.height: visible text ink bounds plus twice verticalPadding

framing.crop: stable per shot; smooth follow only when needed
framing.topHookLayout: default in all five modes; shared text-hook.md

sync.name: EDDIE Sync Reaction
sync.layout: continuous source with synchronized bottom-left inset, then full-screen commentary

async.name: EDDIE Async Reaction
async.layout: full-screen source excerpt, then separately recorded full-screen doctor commentary
async.images: optional relevant supporting images or study excerpts below captions

reaction.selection: Honor explicit choice or approved edit; use footage and brief to select Sync versus Async
reaction.hook: shared top-centered 0–3 second hook; preserve source text and face clearance
